summary: Nano Dimension Ltd. announced via Form 8-K the sale of its wholly owned subsidiary MarkForged, Inc. to Stratasys Ltd. in an all-cash transaction valued at $42.5 million. The sale is part of Nano Dimension's Phase 2 strategic plan, which focuses on monetizing product lines to simplify the business and strengthen the balance sheet. Nano Dimension will retain the Markforged Metal Binder Jetting product line. The transaction is expected to reduce annualized cash burn by approximately $15 million from operating cost savings. No board recommendation, advisors, or closing timeline were specified. Watch for regulatory clearances and any further product line divestitures as part of the ongoing strategic review.
